meta.name: work-with-pr
meta.description: Full PR lifecycle in a fresh task-owned git worktree: implement via the ulw-loop skill with mandatory evidence-bound manual QA → reviewer-readable English PR → verification loop (CI + Cubic, where Cubic is skipped only when its quota is exhausted) → merge by default → worktree cleanup. Decomposes one task into the smallest atomic, independently-mergeable PRs and builds the independent ones concurrently via one worktree per PR driven by parallel subagents or a team. Unbounded loop: any failing gate sends you back to fix-and-re-QA inside that PR's worktree. Use whenever implementation work needs to land as a PR. Triggers: 'create a PR', 'implement and PR', 'work on this and make a PR', 'implement issue', 'land this as a PR', 'split into atomic PRs', 'parallel PRs', 'work-with-pr', 'PR workflow', 'implement end to end', even when user just says 'implement X' if the context implies PR delivery.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将实现任务自动拆分为可合并的PR并完成全流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要将开发任务拆成多个独立PR并自动走完提交流程
copy.tagline_en: Automate full PR lifecycle from task decomposition to merge
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to split development tasks into independent PRs and automate the submission process

howto.what: 它会把大任务拆成若干最小的、可独立合并的改动，各自在独立工作区里并行开发；每个改动都要先在真实环境里手工验证并留下证据，然后写英文 PR，跑 CI 和 Cubic 审核（后者仅在额度耗尽时跳过），失败就回到该 PR 修复重验，直到通过后自动合并并清理。
howto.when: 当用户说“create a PR”“implement and PR”等指令，或直接说“实现 X”且语境明显是交付 PR 时触发。

say.text: 把这个 issue 实现并提交成一个可合并的 PR。
say.note: 触发完整流程：实现→QA→PR→验证→合并。

say.text: 把任务拆成最小的原子 PR，能并行的就并行做。
say.note: 它会按依赖拆分，并为各 PR 同时开工作区。

say.text: 改完先做手工验证，再把证据写进 PR 里。
say.note: 没有验证证据，它不会提交或推送。

howto.what_en: It splits a task into the smallest independent PRs, builds them in parallel worktrees, implements with manual QA, writes an English PR, runs CI and Cubic, skipping Cubic only on quota exhaustion, and loops to fix until merged.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says 'create a PR', 'implement and PR', or just 'implement X' with PR delivery implied; also when they ask for atomic/parallel PRs or the PR workflow.

say_en.text: Implement this issue and land it as a mergeable PR.
say_en.note: Starts the full lifecycle: implement, QA, PR, verify, merge.

say_en.text: Split the task into the smallest atomic PRs and run independent ones in parallel.
say_en.note: It splits by dependency and opens one worktree per PR.

say_en.text: Do manual QA first, then put the evidence in the PR.
say_en.note: Without evidence it will not commit or push.
